name: twinning
rules: Noncoherent domains add intensities, not complex structure amplitudes.
Exact overlap constrains sums; do not report data-only separation without independent rank.
Split twin-related/equivalent observations as closed groups for validation.
Keep candidate-specific paired RES/HKL files; do not reuse original HKL after a basis change.
A model-conditioned detwinned FCF is not new independent experimental data.
TWIN matrix sign is not a detwinning switch; SWAT is a Babinet solvent model.
